summary: Build practical mentoring programme design skills, matching tools, and evaluation templates. Train your team to launch with clarity and measure impact.
lede: Mentoring programme design gives HR, learning and talent professionals a structure for building, running and improving formal workplace mentoring. It covers needs analysis and participant criteria, mentor and mentee preparation, matching frameworks and programme governance, then practical approaches to mentoring conversations and evaluation of participation, satisfaction, retention and progression using scorecards and reporting tools.
audienceIntro: This mentoring programme design and delivery training is for professionals who need to build, run, or improve formal mentoring systems that support development and retention.
prerequisites: Participants should have working knowledge of learning and development, talent management, HR operations, or leadership development processes. No coding is required. Familiarity with programme planning, stakeholder reporting, and basic data tracking is helpful, and the course introduces digital matching and evaluation workflows at a practical, operational level rather than technical engineering depth.
